However, if summoned too close to the exit, it can damage the base. }} ==Description== The '''MiniHand''' was an enemy that appeared in [[The Narratorium]] as a part of [[The Final Act Event]]. It was an enemy that has a decent health and swift speed. It does not appear naturally and instead can only be spawned by the [[Narrator (Enemy)|Narrator]]. The '''MiniHand''' fires bullets at towers in its range of 22.5, which will stun any tower hit for 2.5 seconds and deal 275 damage to units. Additionally, upon reaching the exit, it will go backwards through the path instead of damaging the base. ==Logbook Description== "''The Mini Hands cause a lot of mischief if left alone for too long. Righty and Lefty act as a kind of parent, making sure they don't do anything 'too' reckless. They communicate through gestures and all have unique personalities. Sometimes they will wrestle and throw tantrums and Narrator often refers to them all as ‘Junior’.''" ==Appearance== Like [[Left Hand]] and [[Right Hand]], the '''MiniHand''' is disembodied human hand wearing a white glove. The '''MiniHand''' has a death animation where it will make various hand signals before shrinking into nothing and emitting confetti after it disappears. ==Strategy== *'''MiniHands''' are overall not a major threat, and only serve as a distraction. This role as a distraction is stressed further by their '''Devious Directions''' ability, which makes them loop back through the path. However, they are still considered to be in front of [[Narrator (Enemy)|Narrator]]. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseMinihand.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (20 December 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} DefaultEnemyIconIG.png|'''MiniHand''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Update History== *'''20 December 2025''' - [[v1.83.0|v1.83.0a]] **'''MiniHand''' added. **{{Bug}} '''MiniHand''' has a broken icon. *'''11 March 2026''' - [[v1.86.0]] **'''MiniHand''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:The Final Act Event]]
